The most common type of game is a serious game, and the most common game type is a role playing game.
The use of computerized serious educational games to prevent or reduce alcohol and other drug use among adolescents is an emerging research area.

(1) computerized serious educational games about drugs and alcohol for adolescents are scarce, (2) most games are designed for the general public, (3) the games are mostly designed for prevention purposes, (4) most games have not been evaluated, (5) games that have been evaluated have shown positive effects, (6) games are mostly evaluated in the laboratory, (7) most games have a short duration and (8) games are mostly available for free.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the use of computerized games can be used as a medium to deliver health messages to adolescents in the area of substance use prevention and intervention.
how to develop and implement effective and engaging computerised serious games about AOD for adolescents.
the use of computerised serious games about alcohol and/or other drugs for adolescents, as a means to promote positive attitudes and behaviours.
